title: Simple Buttons
description: This resource pack makes the buttons cleaner inside and less details, it is for minimalism and performance imporvements.
body:
# WHAT THIS PACK IS FOR 🤔
This pack is for a minimalistic feel and it performs better because it has less details and noise in the buttons
# WHY MAKE SUCH PACK 🧐
This pack was made to make Minecraft feel good and minimal, it is **NOT** for monetizing purposes
